notes.title: Demo Playtest
notes.content: [h2]Demo version playtest is coming soon![/h2][h3]You can participate in it from the store page of the game.[/h3][p][/p][p]The playtest will contain demo version of the game. It's purpose is to gather some feedback (and to try the playtest system). You can play the Demo and send me your feedback from the game. I'll try to adjust it according to your feedback, so it's your chance to take part in the development of Void of Lilly![/p][p][/p][p]The Demo Playtest will begin on September 8th and will last for about 2 weeks. Soon after I'll release it as an actual Demo version.[/p]
